revisions.note: Added the per-subject meta.yml (run list with experimental condition and type) that moabb.datasets.BI2013a reads after extraction; it was missing from the original sourcedata snapshot. Each file is the zip member <stem>/meta.yml of the Zenodo record 2669187 archive the loader downloads (session08 for subjects 1-7, matching the loader's extraction order), read with HTTP range requests; CRC-32 checked by zipfile.

Added 219 run files (1.mat x73, 2.mat x73, 4.mat x73) so every run selection of moabb.datasets.BI2013a (adaptive/non_adaptive x training/online, chosen from meta.yml) is in the deposit; before, only SessionN/3.mat (non-adaptive training, the default) was. Members <stem>/SessionN/<k>.mat of the Zenodo 2669187 archives the loader downloads, stored at the loader's extracted path subject_XX/SessionN/<k>.mat; members read with HTTP range requests, CRC-32 and size checked against the archive central directory.

revisions.change: added 73 missing upstream per-subject ZIP archives from Zenodo record 2669187 (byte-identical, MD5 verified against the Zenodo API); the deposit previously held only the extracted Session*/3.mat members, so the BI2013a loader downloaded every ZIP upstream
